question: The National Library of India is situated at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Library of India is located in **Kolkata, West Bengal**.
 
• It is the **largest library in India** by volume and public record.
 
• The National Library is housed in the **Belvedere Estate**, a historic mansion.
 
• It serves as a repository of information for **research and preservation** of all kinds of documents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Library of India**

 
 
• The National Library of India is the **country's largest library** by volume and also the library of public record.
 
• It is an institution under the **Ministry of Culture**, Government of India.
 
• The library’s primary mission is to collect, disseminate, and preserve the cultural and intellectual heritage of the nation.
 
• The National Library is notable for its **vast collection of books, manuscripts, periodicals, and other documents** in multiple languages and disciplines.
 
 
 
• **Belvedere Estate**
 
 
• The Belvedere Estate, where the National Library is housed, was originally the residence of the **Governor-General of India** until 1911.
 
• The estate is located in Alipore, Kolkata, and is a significant historical site.
 
• It features colonial architecture and is surrounded by lush gardens and open spaces.
 
• The estate also includes a number of other buildings that serve different functions related to the library.
 
 
 
• **Library Collections**
 
 
• The National Library boasts an extensive collection of over **2.2 million books**.
 
• It includes rare manuscripts, journals, periodicals, and newspapers dating back several centuries.
 
• The library has a **special collection** of books in Indian languages, foreign languages, and English.
 
• It also serves as a repository for all publications printed in India under the **Delivery of Books and Newspapers (Public Libraries) Act, 1954**.
